inputs.placement: 1-based U index, integer 1–12, from below; U pitch 44.45 mm
inputs.module: 1U x 390 mm; 120 or 900 W at PF 0.80, illustrative
inputs.run: bts.rack-run-input.v1; example-run.json; one UTF-8 mask and one trace with up to 65536 bytes per object
inputs.archiveImport: bts.rack-archive.v1; example-archive.json; IDs, revision, parent links, bytes and SHA-256 remain unchanged during restore

outputs.power: W, VA and estimated RMS-equivalent current in A at 120 V; conservative summed VA
outputs.placement: Physical metric model, rack datum Y=55 mm, positive Y up
outputs.archive: bts.rack-archive.v1; objects by logical ID and embedded UTF-8 text; no network addresses
outputs.restore: In-memory restore event with original run, sample and revision plus per-object checks

failures: Out-of-rail module, duplicate units or exceeded mounting depth
Virtual UPS disabled or real/apparent limit exceeded
Door closed or NAS tray extended during incompatible actions
Wrong schema, mask/trace parent links or any digest/byte count mismatch
limits: No mains switching, networking, persistent storage, user authentication or external access
Checksums compare content to its recorded digest; no signature or authenticity assertion
